SELECT SR.COMPANY_CD, SR.SMR_CD, SR.SMR_CHASU, SR.ITEM_CD, SR.ITEM_NM, SR.EUSER_CD, SR.EUSER_NM, SR.QRUSER_CD, SR.SMP_RQTY, SR.PUR_OQTY, U.USER_NM AS QRUSER_NM, SR.QDEPT_CD, D.DEPT_NM AS QDEPT_NM, SR.RRUSER_CD, U2.USER_NM AS RRUSER_NM, SR.SMR_RAUSER AS RAUSER, U3.USER_NM AS RAUSER_NM, dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'SMP_STATUS',SR.SMP_STATUS) AS SMP_STATUS, CD.CODE_NM AS SMP_STATUS_NM, SR.SMR_RQDATE, SR.SMR_BKDATE AS SMR_BKDATE, SR.SMR_RRDATE AS SMR_RRDATE, SR.SMR_FBDATE AS SMR_FBDATE, SR.SMR_PRDATE AS SMR_PRDATE, P.PRDT_PDATE AS PRDT_PDATE, SR.SHIP_PDATE AS SHIP_PDATE, SR.SMR_RADATE AS SMR_RADATE, SR.SMR_PODATE AS SMR_PODATE, SR.SMR_ORDERDATE AS SMR_ORDERDATE, SR.PROJECT_POSS ,SR.SMP_CD ,P.TRACKING_NUM ,P.PRDT_PDATE2 ,P.DELAY_COMMENT ,dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'SMP_DELAY',P.DELAY_COMMENT) AS DELAY_COMMENT_NM ,P.PROCESS ,dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'SMP_STEP',P.PROCESS) AS PROCESS_NM FROM T_SAMPLE_REQUEST SR LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT SMP_CD, SMP_CHASU,TRACKING_NUM, PRDT_PDATE, PRDT_PDATE2, DELAY_COMMENT, PROCESS FROM T_SAMPLE) P ON SR.SMP_CD = P.SMP_CD AND SR.SMP_CHASU = p.SMP_CHASU LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT COMPANY_CD, USER_CD, case when #language# = 'ENG' then USER_ENG_NM when #language# = 'KOR' then USER_NM else USER_NM end as USER_NM, DEPT_CD, DSTR_CHN FROM T_USER) U ON SR.QRUSER_CD = U.USER_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT COMPANY_CD, USER_CD,
case when #language# = 'ENG' then USER_ENG_NM when #language# = 'KOR' then USER_NM else USER_NM end as USER_NM,
DEPT_CD, DSTR_CHN FROM T_USER) U2 ON SR.RRUSER_CD = U2.USER_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT COMPANY_CD ,DEPT_CD ,case when #language# = 'ENG' then DEPT_ENG_NM when #language# = 'KOR' then DEPT_NM else DEPT_NM end as DEPT_NM ,UP_DEPT_CD FROM T_DEPARTMENT) D ON SR.QDEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT COMPANY_CD, USER_CD, case when #language# = 'ENG' then USER_ENG_NM when #language# = 'KOR' then USER_NM else USER_NM end as USER_NM, DEPT_CD, DSTR_CHN FROM T_USER) U3 ON SR.SMR_RAUSER = U3.USER_CD INNER JOIN ( SELECT CODE_ID, #language# AS CODE_NM FROM T_CODE WHERE UP_CODE_ID = 'SMP_STATUS'
AND VALUE_5 != 'SM'
AND VALUE_5 NOT IN ('RQ','SM')
AND VALUE_5 NOT IN ('RQ','RV','SM')
) CD ON SR.SMP_STATUS = CD.CODE_ID WHERE SR.USE_YN = 'Y'
AND SR.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd#
AND SR.QDEPT_CD = #deptGroup#
AND D.UP_DEPT_CD = #bizGroup# AND SR.QDEPT_CD IS NOT NULL
AND U.DSTR_CHN = #dstr_chn# AND SR.QRUSER_CD IS NOT NULL
AND SR.QRUSER_CD = REPLACE(#user_nm#,'#',' ')
AND SR.QRUSER_CD = REPLACE(#user_cd#,'#',' ')
AND ( ( SR.SMR_RQDATE >= CONVERT(DATE, REPLACE(#sdate#, '-', '')) AND SR.SMR_RQDATE <= CONVERT(DATE, REPLACE(#edate#, '-', '')) ) OR ( SR.SMR_RQDATE IS NULL ) )
AND SR.SMR_RQDATE >= CONVERT(DATE, REPLACE(#sdate#, '-', '')) AND SR.SMR_RQDATE <= CONVERT(DATE, REPLACE(#edate#, '-', ''))
AND SR.SMR_RRDATE >= CONVERT(DATE, REPLACE(#sdate#, '-', '')) AND SR.SMR_RRDATE <= CONVERT(DATE, REPLACE(#edate#, '-', ''))
AND SR.SMR_RQDATE >= REPLACE(#srqdate#,'-','')
AND SR.SMR_RQDATE <= REPLACE(#erqdate#,'-','')
AND SR.SMR_RRDATE >= REPLACE(#srrdate#,'-','')
AND SR.SMR_RRDATE <= REPLACE(#errdate#,'-','')
AND SR.EUSER_CD = #cust_cd#
AND SR.EUSER_NM LIKE '%' + #cust_nm# + '%'
AND SR.ITEM_NM LIKE '%' + #item_nm# + '%'
AND SR.SMP_STATUS = #smp_status#
AND SR.RRUSER_CD != #rruser_cd#
ORDER BY SR.SMR_CD DESC,SR.SMR_CHASU DESC
SELECT CD.CODE_ID , CD.CODE_NM , CD.CODE_$language$ AS CODE_LANG , CD.VALUE_1 , ISNULL(SMR.SMR_CODE,'') SMR_CODE , ISNULL(SMR.SMR_MATERIAL,'') SMR_MATERIAL , ISNULL(SMR.SMR_INJECT,'') SMR_INJECT , ISNULL(SMR.SMR_COAT,'') SMR_COAT , ISNULL(SMR.SMR_HSTMPC,'') SMR_HSTMPC , ISNULL(SMR.SMR_HSTMPD,'') SMR_HSTMPD , ISNULL(SMR.SMR_MOLDNO,'') SMR_MOLDNO , ISNULL(SMR.SMR_SS,'') SMR_SS FROM T_CODE AS CD LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT SMR_PARTNM, SMR_CODE, SMR_MATERIAL, SMR_INJECT, SMR_COAT, SMR_HSTMPC, SMR_HSTMPD, SMR_SS, SMR_MOLDNO FROM $table_nm$ WHERE SMR_CD = #smr_cd# AND SMR_CHASU = #smr_chasu# ) AS SMR ON CD.CODE_ID = SMR.SMR_PARTNM WHERE CD.UP_CODE_ID = #upCodeId# AND CD.VALUE_1 = #value_1# AND CD.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY CD.CODE_ORDER
SELECT $table_cls$ AS CMT FROM $table_nm$ WHERE SMR_CD = #smr_cd# AND SMR_CHASU = #smr_chasu# AND SMR_PARTNM = #smr_partnm#
SELECT SR.COMPANY_CD ,SR.SMR_CD ,SR.SMR_CHASU ,SR.SMP_CD ,SR.SMP_CHASU ,SR.SPEC_YN ,SR.SMR_TYPE ,dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#,'SMR_TYPE',SR.SMR_TYPE) AS SMR_TYPE_NM ,SR.QRUSER_CD ,(SELECT case when #language# = 'ENG' then USER_ENG_NM when #language# = 'KOR' then USER_NM else USER_NM end as USER_NM FROM T_USER WHERE USER_CD = SR.QRUSER_CD) AS QRUSER_NM ,QDEPT_CD ,(SELECT DEPT_NM FROM T_DEPARTMENT WHERE DEPT_CD = SR.QDEPT_CD) AS QDEPT_NM ,RRUSER_CD ,(SELECT case when #language# = 'ENG' then USER_ENG_NM when #language# = 'KOR' then USER_NM else USER_NM end as USER_NM FROM T_USER WHERE USER_CD = SR.RRUSER_CD) AS RRUSER_NM ,SR.EUSER_CD ,SR.EUSER_NM ,SR.ITEM_CD ,SR.ITEM_NM ,SR.SMP_RQTY ,SR.SMP_STATUS ,dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#,'SMP_STATUS',SR.SMP_STATUS) AS SMP_STATUS_NM ,SR.PURP_COLOR ,SR.PURP_DECO ,SR.PURP_TEST ,CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),CONVERT(DATETIME,SR.SMR_RQDATE),23) AS SMR_RQDATE ,CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),CONVERT(DATETIME,SR.SMR_BKDATE),23) AS SMR_BKDATE ,CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),CONVERT(DATETIME,SR.SMR_FBDATE),23) AS SMR_FBDATE ,CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),CONVERT(DATETIME,SR.SMR_RRDATE),23) AS SMR_RRDATE ,CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),CONVERT(DATETIME,SR.SMR_RADATE),23) AS SMR_RADATE
,CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),CONVERT(DATETIME,SR.SMR_RFDATE),23) AS SMR_RFDATE ,CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),CONVERT(DATETIME,SR.SMR_PRDATE),23) AS SMR_PRDATE ,CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),CONVERT(DATETIME,SS.PRDT_PDATE),23) AS PRDT_PDATE ,CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),CONVERT(DATETIME,SS.SHIP_PDATE),23) AS SHIP_PDATE
,SMR_RQUSER ,(SELECT case when #language# = 'ENG' then USER_ENG_NM when #language# = 'KOR' then USER_NM else USER_NM end as USER_NM FROM T_USER WHERE USER_CD = SR.SMR_RQUSER) AS SMR_RQUSER_NM ,SMR_BKUSER ,(SELECT case when #language# = 'ENG' then USER_ENG_NM when #language# = 'KOR' then USER_NM else USER_NM end as USER_NM FROM T_USER WHERE USER_CD = SR.SMR_BKUSER) AS SMR_BKUSER_NM ,SMR_FBUSER ,(SELECT case when #language# = 'ENG' then USER_ENG_NM when #language# = 'KOR' then USER_NM else USER_NM end as USER_NM FROM T_USER WHERE USER_CD = SR.SMR_FBUSER) AS SMR_FBUSER_NM ,SMR_RRUSER ,(SELECT case when #language# = 'ENG' then USER_ENG_NM when #language# = 'KOR' then USER_NM else USER_NM end as USER_NM FROM T_USER WHERE USER_CD = SR.SMR_RRUSER) AS SMR_RRUSER_NM ,SMR_RAUSER ,(SELECT case when #language# = 'ENG' then USER_ENG_NM when #language# = 'KOR' then USER_NM else USER_NM end as USER_NM FROM T_USER WHERE USER_CD = SR.SMR_RAUSER) AS SMR_RAUSER_NM ,SMR_RFUSER ,(SELECT case when #language# = 'ENG' then USER_ENG_NM when #language# = 'KOR' then USER_NM else USER_NM end as USER_NM FROM T_USER WHERE USER_CD = SR.SMR_RFUSER) AS SMR_RFUSER_NM ,SMR_PRUSER ,(SELECT case when #language# = 'ENG' then USER_ENG_NM when #language# = 'KOR' then USER_NM else USER_NM end as USER_NM FROM T_USER WHERE USER_CD = SR.SMR_PRUSER) AS SMR_PRUSER_NM ,SR.ARTWORK_NO ,SR.PACKING_INFO ,dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#,'PACKING_INFO',SR.PACKING_INFO) AS PACKING_INFO_NM ,SR.SHIP_TO_ADRS ,SR.REMARK_CMT ,SR.PRDT_YN ,SR.DROP_YN ,SR.USE_YN ,(SELECT (CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) FROM T_SMR_RETURN WHERE SMR_CD = SR.SMR_CD AND SMR_CHASU = SR.SMR_CHASU ) AS REQ_RETURN_YN ,(SELECT (CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) FROM T_SMR_REVIEW WHERE SMR_CD = SR.SMR_CD AND SMR_CHASU = SR.SMR_CHASU ) AS REQ_REVIEW_YN ,(SELECT (CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) FROM T_SMR_CREPAIR WHERE SMR_CD = SR.SMR_CD AND SMR_CHASU = SR.SMR_CHASU) AS REQ_REPAIR_YN ,SR.PUR_OQTY
,CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),CONVERT(DATETIME,SR.SMR_CRDATE),23) AS SMR_CRDATE ,CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),CONVERT(DATETIME,SR.SMR_PODATE),23) AS SMR_PODATE ,SS.TRACKING_NUM ,PROJECT_POSS ,CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),CONVERT(DATETIME,SR.SMR_ORDERDATE),23) AS SMR_ORDERDATE ,ISNULL(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_ATTACH_FILE WHERE BIZ_GUBUN = SR.SMR_CD AND CHASU = SR.SMR_CHASU AND DOC_MGT = 'sampleDec' ),0) AS SMP_DETAIL_FILE_CNT ,( SELECT MAX(SMR_CHASU) FROM T_SAMPLE_REQUEST WHERE SMR_CD = SR.SMR_CD ) AS MAX_CHASU ,SR.SMR_COMMENT ,ISNULL(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_SAMPLE_SPEC WHERE SMP_CD = ISNULL(SR.SMP_CD,'') AND SMP_CHASU = ISNULL(SR.SMP_CHASU,0) ),0) AS SPECCHK_CNT FROM T_SAMPLE_REQUEST SR LEFT OUTER JOIN T_SAMPLE AS SS ON SR.SMR_CD = SS.SMR_CD AND SR.SMR_CHASU = SS.SMR_CHASU WHERE SR.SMR_CD = #smr_cd# AND SR.SMR_CHASU = #smr_chasu#
SELECT EXTR_DIAMETER ,EXTR_LAYER ,EXTR_LENGTH ,EXTR_COLOR ,EXTR_MB ,NECK_MOLD ,NECK_ORIFICE ,NECK_COLOR ,NECK_MB ,ARLS_COLOR ,ARLS_SILICON ,OFFSET_FILMNO ,OFFSET_PASS ,OFFSET_COATING ,SS_FILMNO ,SS_PASS ,HS_FILMNO ,HS_PASS ,CAP_SPEC ,CAP_ORIFICE ,CAP_OUTERCOLOR ,CAP_INNERCOLOR ,CAP_DECO ,CAP_SUPPLIER ,CAP_SAFETYSEAL FROM T_SAMPLE_PRDTINFO WHERE SMR_CD = #smr_cd# AND SMR_CHASU = #smr_chasu#
SELECT ('SMR' + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12),GETDATE(),112),3,2) + dbo.FN_LPAD( CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), CONVERT(INTEGER,( CASE WHEN MAX(SMR_CD) IS NULL THEN '0' ELSE SUBSTRING(MAX(SMR_CD), 6,10) END ) )+1),5,'0') ) AS SMR_CD FROM T_SAMPLE_REQUEST
INSERT INTO T_SAMPLE_REQUEST( COMPANY_CD ,SMR_CD ,SMR_CHASU ,SMR_TYPE ,QRUSER_CD ,QDEPT_CD ,EUSER_CD ,EUSER_NM ,ITEM_CD ,ITEM_NM ,SMP_RQTY ,SMP_STATUS ,PURP_COLOR ,PURP_DECO ,PURP_TEST ,ARTWORK_NO ,PACKING_INFO ,SHIP_TO_ADRS ,REMARK_CMT ,REG_USR ,REG_DT ,PUR_OQTY ,SMR_CRDATE ,SMR_PODATE ,SMR_ORDERDATE ,PROJECT_POSS ,SMR_COMMENT )VALUES( #company_cd# ,#smr_cd# ,#smr_chasu# ,#smr_type# ,#qruser_cd# ,#qdept_cd# ,#euser_cd# ,#euser_nm# ,#item_cd# ,#item_nm# ,#smp_rqty# ,#smp_status# ,#purp_color# ,#purp_deco# ,#purp_test# ,#artwork_no# ,#packing_info# ,#ship_to_adrs# ,#remark_cmt# ,#reg_usr# ,getdate() ,#pur_oqty#
,REPLACE(#smr_crdate#,'-','')
,NULL
,REPLACE(#smr_podate#,'-','')
,NULL
,REPLACE(#smr_orderdate#,'-','')
,NULL
,#project_poss#
,#smr_comment#
,NULL
)
IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM T_SAMPLE_PRDTINFO WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND SMR_CD = #smr_cd# AND SMR_CHASU = #smr_chasu# )
INSERT INTO T_SAMPLE_PRDTINFO( COMPANY_CD ,SMR_CD ,SMR_CHASU ,EXTR_DIAMETER ,EXTR_LAYER ,EXTR_LENGTH ,EXTR_COLOR ,EXTR_MB ,NECK_MOLD ,NECK_ORIFICE ,NECK_COLOR ,NECK_MB ,ARLS_COLOR ,ARLS_SILICON ,OFFSET_FILMNO ,OFFSET_PASS ,OFFSET_COATING ,SS_FILMNO ,SS_PASS ,HS_FILMNO ,HS_PASS ,CAP_SPEC ,CAP_ORIFICE ,CAP_OUTERCOLOR ,CAP_INNERCOLOR ,CAP_DECO ,CAP_SUPPLIER ,CAP_SAFETYSEAL ,REG_DT ,REG_USR )VALUES( #company_cd# ,#smr_cd# ,#smr_chasu# ,#extr_diameter# ,#extr_layer# ,#extr_length# ,#extr_color# ,#extr_mb# ,#neck_mold# ,#neck_orifice# ,#neck_color# ,#neck_mb# ,#arls_color# ,#arls_silicon# ,#offset_filmno# ,#offset_pass# ,#offset_coating# ,#ss_filmno# ,#ss_pass# ,#hs_filmno# ,#hs_pass# ,#cap_spec# ,#cap_orifice# ,#cap_outercolor# ,#cap_innercolor# ,#cap_deco# ,#cap_supplier# ,#cap_safetyseal# ,GETDATE() ,#reg_usr# ) ELSE UPDATE T_SAMPLE_PRDTINFO SET EXTR_DIAMETER = #extr_diameter# ,EXTR_LAYER = #extr_layer# ,EXTR_LENGTH = #extr_length# ,EXTR_COLOR = #extr_color# ,EXTR_MB = #extr_mb# ,NECK_MOLD = #neck_mold# ,NECK_ORIFICE = #neck_orifice# ,NECK_COLOR = #neck_color# ,NECK_MB = #neck_mb# ,ARLS_COLOR = #arls_color# ,ARLS_SILICON = #arls_silicon# ,OFFSET_FILMNO = #offset_filmno# ,OFFSET_PASS = #offset_pass# ,OFFSET_COATING = #offset_coating# ,SS_FILMNO = #ss_filmno# ,SS_PASS = #ss_pass# ,HS_FILMNO = #hs_filmno# ,HS_PASS = #hs_pass# ,CAP_SPEC = #cap_spec# ,CAP_ORIFICE = #cap_orifice# ,CAP_OUTERCOLOR = #cap_outercolor# ,CAP_INNERCOLOR = #cap_innercolor# ,CAP_DECO = #cap_deco# ,CAP_SUPPLIER = #cap_supplier# ,CAP_SAFETYSEAL = #cap_safetyseal# ,MOD_DT = GETDATE() ,MOD_USR = #mod_usr# WHERE SMR_CD = #smr_cd# AND SMR_CHASU = #smr_chasu#
UPDATE T_SAMPLE_REQUEST SET SMR_TYPE = #smr_type# ,EUSER_CD = #euser_cd# ,EUSER_NM = #euser_nm# ,ITEM_CD = #item_cd# ,ITEM_NM = #item_nm# ,SMP_RQTY = #smp_rqty# ,SMP_STATUS = #smp_status# ,PURP_COLOR = #purp_color# ,PURP_DECO = #purp_deco# ,PURP_TEST = #purp_test# ,ARTWORK_NO = #artwork_no# ,PACKING_INFO = #packing_info# ,SHIP_TO_ADRS = #ship_to_adrs# ,REMARK_CMT = #remark_cmt# ,MOD_DT = GETDATE() ,MOD_USR = #mod_usr# ,PUR_OQTY = #pur_oqty#
,SPEC_YN = #spec_yn#
,SMR_CRDATE = REPLACE(#smr_crdate#,'-','')
,SMR_CRDATE = NULL
,SMR_PODATE = REPLACE(#smr_podate#,'-','')
,SMR_PODATE = NULL
,SMR_ORDERDATE = REPLACE(#smr_orderdate#,'-','')
,SMR_ORDERDATE = NULL
,PROJECT_POSS = #project_poss#
,SMR_COMMENT = #smr_comment#
WHERE SMR_CD = #smr_cd# AND SMR_CHASU = #smr_chasu#
hash["artwork_no"] = Request["artwork_no"].nullToStr(); hash["packing_info"] = Request["packing_info"].nullToStr();
UPDATE T_SAMPLE_REQUEST SET SMP_STATUS = #smp_status#
,SMR_RQUSER = #smr_rquser# ,SMR_RQDATE = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8),GETDATE(),112)
,SMR_BKUSER = #smr_bkuser# ,SMR_BKDATE = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8),GETDATE(),112)
,RRUSER_CD = #smr_rruser# ,SMR_RRUSER = #smr_rruser# ,SMR_RRDATE = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8),GETDATE(),112)
,SMR_FBUSER = #smr_fbuser# ,SMR_FBDATE = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8),GETDATE(),112)
,SMR_RAUSER = #smr_rauser# ,SMR_RADATE = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8),GETDATE(),112)
,SMR_RFUSER = #smr_rfuser# ,SMR_RFDATE = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8),GETDATE(),112)
,SPEC_YN = #spec_yn# ,SMR_PRUSER = #smr_pruser# ,SMR_PRDATE = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8),REPLACE(#smr_prdate#,'-',''),112)
,ARTWORK_NO = #artwork_no#
,PACKING_INFO = #packing_info#
,PRDT_YN = 'Y'
,DROP_YN = 'Y'
,USE_YN = 'N'
,SMR_CHASU = #change_smr_charsu#
,SMR_COMMENT = #smr_comment#
WHERE SMR_CD = #smr_cd# AND SMR_CHASU = #smr_chasu#
DELETE FROM $table_nm$ WHERE SMR_CD = #smr_cd# AND SMR_CHASU = #smr_chasu#

,SMR_CODE
,SMR_MATERIAL
,SMR_INJECT
,SMR_COAT
,SMR_HSTMPC
,SMR_HSTMPD
,SMR_SS
,SMR_MOLDNO
,SMR_PKG
,REMARK_CMT
,REG_DT ,REG_USR )VALUES( #company_cd# ,#smr_cd# ,#smr_chasu# ,#smr_partnm#
,#smr_code#

SELECT (ISNULL(MAX(SMR_SEQ),0) + 1) AS SMR_SEQ FROM T_SMR_RETURN WHERE SMR_CD = #smr_cd# AND SMR_CHASU = #smr_chasu#
INSERT INTO T_SMR_RETURN (COMPANY_CD ,SMR_CD ,SMR_CHASU ,SMR_SEQ ,USER_CD ,SMR_RTDATE ,SMR_RTTYPE ,SMR_RTDESCRIPT ,REG_DT ,REG_USR) VALUES ( #company_cd# ,#smr_cd# ,#smr_chasu# ,#smr_seq# ,#user_cd# ,CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8),GETDATE(),112) ,#smr_rttype# ,#smr_rtdescript# ,GETDATE() ,#reg_usr# )
SELECT COMPANY_CD ,SMR_CD ,SMR_CHASU ,USER_CD ,dbo.FN_GET_USER_NM(USER_CD) AS USER_NM ,dbo.FN_GET_USER_TO_DEPT_NM(USER_CD) DEPT_NM ,SMR_CRDATE ,SMR_CRTYPE ,SMR_CRDESCRIPT FROM T_SMR_CREPAIR WHERE SMR_CD = #smr_cd# AND SMR_CHASU = #smr_chasu#
SELECT COMPANY_CD ,SMR_CD ,SMR_CHASU ,USER_CD ,dbo.FN_GET_USER_NM(USER_CD) AS USER_NM ,dbo.FN_GET_USER_TO_DEPT_NM(USER_CD) DEPT_NM ,SMR_DRDATE ,SMR_DRTYPE ,SMR_DRDESCRIPT FROM T_SMR_DROP WHERE SMR_CD = #smr_cd# AND SMR_CHASU = #smr_chasu#
